_comment: Copy this file, rename it for your employer, and replace every value. Paths may be absolute or relative to this file. Nothing here is company-specific — these are neutral placeholder values chosen to demonstrate the shape.

colors._comment: headline/subline are type. surface is the field's interior; canvas is what every edge feathers to — set canvas to the page background the cover will sit against. aura is [sky, lit, deep]: a mid brand hue, a near-white lift of it, and a deep undertone. kiss is an optional fourth accent, or null.

copy._comment: headline is an array — one entry per line. Two short lines read best at 1584x396; three is the ceiling. Keep each line under about 22 characters so it never wraps.
headline: Short claim here.
Second line here.
copy.subline: One plain sentence saying what the company does.

_layout_comment: content_left defaults to 408px, which clears LinkedIn's desktop profile circle (measured to end at 368px) with a 40px gap. Only lower it if you have removed the text from the lower left.
